title: Visual Expansion
body:
![Mod's banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddf13944b1c398ef5858e5cdc18ef531a22e0df3.png)
**Visual Expansion – Enhance Your Vanilla Experience!**                        
Want to keep the classic Minecraft feel but wish it looked and ran better? Visual Expansion is a lightweight modpack designed to give your game a fresh coat of paint without straying from the core vanilla experience.

- **Smooth Performance** – Includes optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight to boost FPS and reduce lag.
- **Subtle Visual Upgrades** – Enjoy improved lighting, better foliage, enhanced particles, and clean UI tweaks that keep Minecraft looking authentic—just better.
- **Vanilla-Friendly Aesthetic** – No over-the-top or drastic changes—just thoughtful enhancements that make the world more immersive.

Whether you're building, exploring, or just chilling, Visual Expansion brings new life to Minecraft without compromising its charm.
